# For the journey's zin_eindil.140: fires zin_ending.80 fourteen days later to the Host of Eindil if it exists, else the Aenor realm holding Parim, else the original Aenor country.
zin_ending_heir_lost = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				zin_eindil_is_host = yes
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_eindil_is_host = yes
			}
			country_event = {
				id = zin_ending.80
				days = 14
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		zin_aenor_event_for_parim = yes
		event_target:zin_aenor_parim_realm = {
			country_event = {
				id = zin_ending.80
				days = 14
			}
		}
	}
}
